answers.original_model_text: The U.S. Supreme Court decided FDA v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine on June 13, 2024. Justice Kavanaugh wrote for a unanimous Court; Justice Thomas concurred separately. The plaintiffs lacked Article III standing, so the Court reversed the Fifth Circuit’s judgment and remanded. The disposition was jurisdictional, not a decision that the challenged FDA actions were lawful on the merits.

The Court reviewed FDA’s 2016 and 2021 mifepristone actions. The 2016 changes included use through ten weeks of pregnancy, prescribing by providers such as nurse practitioners, and reducing required in-person visits to one; in 2021 FDA stopped enforcing the initial in-person visit requirement. Four anti-abortion medical associations and several individual doctors challenged the actions. Their broader suit also attacked the 2000 and 2019 approvals, but certiorari here concerned the 2016 and 2021 actions. Danco intervened to defend FDA’s actions.

The Court held that federal conscience protections broke the claimed causal chain: even assuming more emergency treatment following FDA’s changes, the doctors did not show they could be forced to provide treatment over conscience objections. No such compelled treatment since the 2000 approval was identified, and EMTALA did not override those protections or compel individual doctors to perform abortions. Alleged economic injuries—diverted time and resources, liability risk and insurance costs—were too speculative and attenuated, without supporting evidence that FDA’s actions caused those harms or persuasive evidence of future harm. These were the plaintiffs’ asserted injuries and the Court’s reasons for rejecting standing, not independently established harms.

No. Without a concrete injury caused by FDA, the associations could not manufacture standing by spending money on research, petitions, public education or advocacy against its actions. They still had to meet ordinary injury, causation and redressability requirements. The Court distinguished Havens: the discriminatory misinformation there directly impaired a housing counseling service’s core activities; FDA had imposed no comparable impediment on these associations’ advocacy businesses.

In this case §922(g)(8)(C)(i) applied to such a finding; the firearm restriction lasted while the person remained subject to the restraining order. This upheld the statute against Rahimi’s facial challenge because it was constitutional as applied to his case, not a general approval of permanent disarmament or every imaginable application.

Historical surety laws and going-armed laws supported a tradition of preventing threatened physical violence through individualized restraints. The Court compared why and how modern and historical laws burdened the right: a judicial threat finding, a limited duration, and a response to demonstrated danger. It required a relevant historical analogue, not an identical law or historical twin, and held that these traditions supported §922(g)(8) as applied here.

answers.original_model_text: The UK Supreme Court decided Finch v Surrey County Council on 20 June 2024. By a three-to-two majority it allowed the appeal and held the council’s grant of planning permission unlawful for omitting the oil’s eventual combustion emissions from the required assessment. Lord Leggatt gave the majority judgment, joined by Lord Kitchin and Lady Rose; Lord Sales dissented with Lord Richards.

The assessment excluded greenhouse-gas emissions from the eventual burning, elsewhere as fuel after refining, of the oil extracted at Horse Hill. It considered only direct greenhouse-gas releases within the well-site boundary during the project’s life. The omitted category was downstream combustion, not merely emissions physically produced during extraction.

On the agreed facts, combustion of the extracted oil was inevitable, its climate impact significant, and the resulting emissions readily estimable. The majority therefore regarded those emissions as effects of the extraction project that the EIA had to assess. Neither combustion elsewhere nor intervening refining broke that connection: the Directive imposed no geographical limit on environmental effects, and refining did not change the oil’s basic nature or intended use. The certainty about oil distinguished more conjectural downstream uses of materials such as steel. These are the majority’s conclusions on agreed facts, not an independent scientific verification or a rule for every industrial supply chain.

It required the authority to understand, expose to public debate and consider the environmental consequences before deciding. An adverse environmental assessment therefore did not automatically require refusal, but omitting legally required assessment made this decision unlawful.

answers.original_model_text: The U.S. Supreme Court decided Trump v. United States on July 1, 2024. Chief Justice Roberts delivered the Court’s opinion. It vacated the D.C. Circuit judgment and remanded for further proceedings consistent with the opinion.

To overcome the minimum protection for an official act, the Government must show that applying a criminal prohibition to that act would pose no danger of intrusion on the Executive Branch’s authority and functions.

The majority reasoned that separation of powers requires protecting the Executive’s independence and effective functioning. Threats of criminal trial, judgment and imprisonment could distort presidential decisions and produce undue caution in exercising constitutional duties. 2022년 7월 이전에 바이러스가 관찰되지 않았던 여러 국가로 성접촉을 통해 빠르게 확산하면서 선포된 PHEIC는 전 세계 사례가 지속적으로 감소한 뒤 2023년 5월 종료됐다고 WHO가 설명한다.

answers.original_model_text: FDA는 알츠하이머병 치료제 Kisunla(donanemab-azbt) 주사제를 승인했다. 치료 시작 대상은 경도 인지장애 또는 경도 치매 단계 환자이며 첨부 허가사항은 투여 전 amyloid beta 병리 확인을 요구한다.
4주 간격의 정맥주입이다. 제공된 2024 허가사항 기준으로 처음 세 번은 700 mg, 이후 1400 mg이며 약 30분에 걸쳐 주입한다.

FDA가 설명한 위약대조 연구에서 76주 전체/통합 집단의 임상 저하가 유의하게 감소했다. iADRS 위약 대비 차이는 2.92(p<0.0001), CDR-SB는 -0.70(p<0.0001)이다. 표8의 CDR-SB 기저 대비 변화는 Kisunla 1.72, 위약 2.42로, 회복이나 완치를 입증한 것이 아니라 저하 속도 감소다. ADAS-Cog13 차이는 -1.33, ADCS-iADL은 1.70이다.

박스 경고는 amyloid-related imaging abnormalities(ARIA)다. ARIA-E는 부종, ARIA-H는 hemosiderin 침착을 포함한다. 대개 무증상이지만 드물게 중증·생명위협 사건이 가능하다. 이 계열 치료제에서는 일부 치명적인 1 cm 초과 뇌내출혈도 관찰됐다. ApoE ε4 동형접합자는 증상성·중증 ARIA 위험이 더 높으며 치료 전 유전자 상태 검사가 권고된다.
